product.title: 3D Bubble Letter Necklace
product.descriptionHtml:
A little shine. A lasting connection.

For the person who makes ordinary days feel special. This 3D bubble letter necklace brings a softly rounded silhouette and a polished finish to an everyday favorite — a thoughtful birthday, anniversary, or just-because gift.

Find your everyday fit

  • Stainless-steel construction
  • Gold-tone, silver-tone, and rose-gold-tone finish options
  • 16-, 18-, and 20-inch chain lengths
  • Listed designs with no engraving or name customization

Choose your necklace

Select your style, finish, and chain length above, then add it to your cart. This necklace is sold in the listed designs and is not customizable.

Choose a style marked “Rose Box” for the rose-style presentation box. For questions about a design or what is included, contact us before ordering.

Keep it looking its best

Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth after wear. Remove before showering, swimming, or applying perfume, and store separately. Explore our jewelry care guide for more tips.
